notes: Git status and commit history are authoritative; this handoff is navigation metadata.
M3-P0 and M3-P1 are preparatory work only and do not mean M3 production is complete.
M2-P0 provider/service-neutral preparation is complete; M2 production remains blocked and not started until the M1 winner is selected by the user.
Future private Xia Yizhou voice-cloud compatibility is documented in .xiafork/m2-local-tts-provider.md; no public or remote TTS service, endpoint, credential, or network exposure was implemented.
No SullyOS runtime success is asserted for the external TTS evaluation.
W1 includes AUTOPILOT_STALL_WATCHDOG: 15 minutes without observable progress triggers a read-only self-check, not a task timeout.
The watchdog must classify the state as ACTIVE, AGENT_STALL, or PROCESS_STALL and continue or safe-stop without blind reset-and-retry behavior.
Known W1 limitation: a worker already stuck in an agent-side stall may be unable to invoke its own self-watchdog; the stalled Agent must never be the sole owner of stall detection and recovery.

W3-P0 implements an external deterministic watcher with an execution lifecycle independent of the worker and separates Agent liveness from task or child-process liveness using observable progress signals.

W3-P0 stores durable run checkpoints, leases, observable evidence, and recovery bundles only under Git-ignored .xiafork/runtime/; these files must not contain chat transcripts, secrets, credentials, or tokens.
W3-P0 uses a minimum single-owner lease that rejects silent owner replacement; it does not steal leases or start replacement Agents.
On AGENT_STALL, W3-P0 may invoke a short-lived Supervisor Codex through the supported non-interactive CLI in an ephemeral read-only sandbox; the deterministic watcher owns timing.

The harmless local demo generated a recovery bundle and launched Codex 0.147.0 with approval=never and sandbox=read-only; the assessment could not complete because the current execution policy blocked outbound API access, and that boundary was not bypassed.
W3 takeover must inherit the original authorized scope, hard stops, forbidden paths, human-only boundaries, and safety constraints; replacement never expands authority.
W3-P0 is implemented but full W3 is not complete; W3-P1 automatic replacement and takeover remains FUTURE and is not authorized.
